notes.title: Restoring latest patch
notes.content:
Had issue with previous patch causing the very first battle to break (G+ H would loop the charge up sound and not progress to battle). I previously restored the old safe version, but now returning the to the new version.

This patch adds script execution ordering for scripts associated with the battle manager, hopefully fixing the ghost notes glitch.
Also makes some routing in Route_11 a little easier!

notes.title: Reverting patch, critical error in first duet with Brusko
notes.content: Reverting due to bug on playing first battle, will sort out Script Execution, then patch.
